title_candidates: Early Fable 5 users love the power and hate the uncertainty
summary: Early Claude Fable 5 reviews praise its long-task coding ability, but users are frustrated by price, speed, hidden interventions, and broad science/security guardrails.

primary_source.title: Initial impressions of Claude Fable 5
primary_source.author: Simon Willison
key_facts: Simon Willison reported strong early results after several hours testing Fable 5 on difficult software tasks.
His positive assessment also emphasized that Fable 5 is slower and more expensive than normal daily-use models.
The most positive user reports cluster around long, difficult coding and agent workflows.
